segments.thag2.10:1.1: “Pubbe hanati attānaṃ, pacchā hanati so pare;
segments.thag2.10:2.1: “Na brāhmaṇo bahivaṇṇo, anto vaṇṇo hi brāhmaṇo;
segments.thag2.10:2.3: Yasmiṃ pāpāni kammāni, sa ve kaṇho sujampatī”ti.
segments.thag2.10:3.1: Uttaro ceva piṇḍolo, valliyo tīriyo isi;
segments.thag2.10:3.3: Ajino ca meḷajino, rādho surādho gotamo;
segments.thag2.10:3.5: Vasabhena ime honti, dasa therā mahiddhikāti.

lines: Evaṃ bāhiraparimajjanamatte ṭhitā puggalā suddhā nāma na honti, abbhantarasuddhiyā eva pana suddhā hontīti dassento “na brāhmaṇo”ti dutiyaṃ gāthamāha.
Abbhantare pana sīlādisampattiyā brāhmaṇo hoti,“bāhitapāpo brāhmaṇo”ti katvā.
Tasmā “yasmiṃ pāpāni lāmakāni kammāni saṃvijjanti, ekaṃsena so kaṇho nihīnapuggalo”ti sujampati, devānaminda, jānāhi.
Taṃ sutvā sakko kuhakabhikkhuṃ tajjetvā “dhamme vattāhī”ti ovaditvā sakaṭṭhānameva gato.
